item.title: US and Israel launch joint strike in Iran, US official says
item.description: Israel and the US have launched a joint attack on Iran, officials say. President Trump confirmed the US military began "major combat operations."

item.title: Sleepy owl found resting among items on a New York antique store shelf
item.description: The state Department of Environmental Conservation said Friday that the incident happened on Feb. 21 in the hamlet of East Durham, about 127 miles (204 kilometers) north of Manhattan.

item.title: What to know about US-Israel attacks on Iran
item.description: The attacks came a day after Trump voiced frustration over lack of progress in negotiations to stop Iran's ability to develop nuclear weapons.

item.title: Immigration advocates, community leaders protest proposed ICE detention center in New Jersey
item.description: Hundreds of residents have been showing up to meetings to voice their concerns over the proposed detention site, which has already been purchased by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security.

item.title: New York, New Jersey lawmakers react after joint US-Israel strike on Iran
item.description: Reaction is pouring in from local lawmakers in New York and New Jersey after the U.S. and Israel launched a joint attack striking Iran.

item.title: AccuWeather: Morning snow, colder
item.description: After our first 50s since January 14th, winter returns on Sunday with some morning/midday snow and flurries.

item.title: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Iran's supreme leader, is dead, Trump says
item.description: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, 86, the supreme leader of Iran, was killed in the U.S.-Israeli attack on the country Saturday, President Donald Trump said.

item.title: Times Square rally voices strong opposition of joint attack on Iran
item.description: Rallies voiced strong opposition and condemned the attacks, amid fear of the consequences for the strikes.

item.title: NYPD boosts security at sensitive sites amid attack on Iran
item.description: The NYPD says it is increasing security around sensitive locations across New York City as tensions escalate in Iran and the wider Middle East.

item.title: Mother killed, teenage son hurt after being stabbed inside Bronx apartment
item.description: The mother suffered wounds to her neck, back and torso. The son was stabbed in the neck and back. He is currently in stable condition.
